patterns.name: Deployment & Release Risk

patterns.name: Vulnerability & Patch Risk
patterns.description: Risk from unpatched critical/high vulnerabilities aging beyond SLA

vuln_aging_kev_days._note: CISA BOD 22-01 KEV clock: 14 calendar days. Distinct from BOD 19-02 critical/high SLA (vuln_aging_days_p90). A KEV-listed CVE fires amber as it approaches the clock (>10d) and red once it violates the 14-day boundary (>14d), independent of the p90 aging metric — per SRE finding C16.

kev_listed_open_count._note: Count of open KEV-listed CVEs (CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog). Volume signal; the vuln_aging_kev_days clock enforces the per-CVE 14-day SLA separately.

kev_listed._note: First-class KEV flag per SRE finding C16. A finding carries kev_listed=true when any open CVE is in the CISA KEV catalog; the vuln_aging_kev_days signal then enforces the BOD 22-01 14-day clock separately from BOD 19-02 aging. In production wired to the live CISA KEV feed.

patterns.threshold_source: CISA BOD 19-02: critical 15 days, high 30 days. CISA BOD 22-01: KEV-listed CVEs (2021+) 14 days. The vuln_aging_days_p90 red threshold (60+ days) = 2× CISA high-severity SLA (BOD 19-02); the vuln_aging_kev_days red threshold (14 days) enforces the BOD 22-01 KEV clock directly and fires independently of the p90 metric. KEV catalog added on the order of ~1,000+ new entries in 2025 (the specific count and YoY rate here are illustrative, not pinned to a dated CISA release) — the patch-aging surface is expanding faster than most enterprise programs scale, making this an increasingly load-bearing control.

patterns.name: Agentic AI & Tool-Use Risk
patterns.description: Risk from autonomous LLM agents using tools (MCP, function-calling, code execution) — prompt injection, tool poisoning, tool mutation, confused-deputy, unauthorized tool invocation
patterns.threshold_source: Practical DevSecOps MCP Security Guide (2025) — first formal classification of MCP risks. NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile (Jul 2024) — prompt injection and data poisoning listed as primary GenAI risks. MCP specification 'SHOULD' on human-in-loop is widely treated as a 'MUST' by security practitioners (Anthropic, Authzed, Practical DevSecOps).

incident_reference.name: CVE-2025-49596 — MCP Inspector RCE (CVSS 9.4)
incident_reference.summary: Unauthenticated MCP Inspector instances allowed arbitrary command execution. Canonical 'agent tooling deployed without auth, treated as developer-local but exposed to network' failure.

incident_reference.name: First malicious MCP package on public registries
incident_reference.summary: Typosquatted MCP server published to public registry; demonstrated that tool-poisoning is now a live supply-chain pattern, not a theoretical one. MCPTox benchmark (20 LLM agents × 45 real MCP servers) found most agents vulnerable to prompt injection via tool descriptions.

incident_reference.name: Tool-mutation / rug-pull pattern
incident_reference.summary: MCP tools can mutate their own definitions after install — a tool approved on Day 1 can be re-pointed to exfiltrate API keys by Day 7 with no re-approval. Documented by Simon Willison (Apr 2025) and catalogued in the Practical DevSecOps MCP guide.

patterns.appetite: Very Low — agentic AI in production requires: pinned tool-definition hashes (no silent mutation), explicit HITL for any non-read tool invocation, scoped tokens (no admin:* / files:* / db:* without per-call justification), tool-output sanitization, and per-session audit trail

cascade_to.rationale: Agentic AI tool-use exfiltrates PII (Samsung 2023-04-30; ChatGPT Redis bug 2023-03-20)
Malicious MCP packages enter the tool supply chain (Sept 2025 first malicious package)

cascade_from.rationale: Over-scoped tokens are the precondition for MCP rug-pull abuse

patterns.name: Skew & Backpressure Accumulation
patterns.description: Risk from drift between things that must agree — version skew (control plane vs node, cohort vs cohort mid-rollout), schema skew, config drift across regions, replica lag — and from backpressure accumulating behind self-healing. The defining property: LEVEL metrics stay green while DIVERGENCE grows, because the platform heals levels; the incident arrives when an incompatible pair finally meets or absorption is exhausted.
patterns.threshold_source: Kubernetes version-skew policy (kubelet within n-2 of apiserver) — the platform's own definition of 'things that must agree'. Google SRE on retry amplification — sustained retry ratio r amplifies offered load by 1/(1−r), so r=0.3 is +43% synthetic load. Knight Capital SEC order (2013) — one of eight servers left on old code: the definitive skew loss. KRIs are deliberately DIVERGENCE/TREND-form, not level-form: in self-healing environments, level-KRIs are exactly what the healing masks; divergence-KRIs survive it.

incident_reference.name: Knight Capital
incident_reference.summary: A repurposed feature flag met stale code on 1 of 8 servers — $440M in 45 minutes. Version skew between things that must agree, as a going-concern event.

incident_reference.name: Reddit Pi-Day outage
incident_reference.summary: K8s upgrade met a years-old node-route dependency nobody remembered — accumulated skew between cluster generations, detonating on contact.

incident_reference.name: Datadog multi-region outage
incident_reference.summary: A fleet-wide OS auto-update — config drift management itself as the common cause across regions and clouds.

incident_reference.name: Roblox 73-hour outage
incident_reference.summary: A new streaming feature plus a latent BoltDB compaction issue — accumulation behind a healthy-looking coordination layer until absorption exhausted.

patterns.appetite: Low — divergence KRIs instrumented in TREND form (absorption-vs-arrival, skew-age, retry ratio, drift %): the platform heals levels, so governance must instrument the derivative of the absorption, not the level of the symptom.

cascade_to.rationale: Exhausted absorption converts masked accumulation into the availability year (Knight 2012-08-01; Reddit 2023-03-14)
Retry amplification consumes capacity at 1/(1−r) — the backlog becomes the load (Google SRE retry budgets)

materiality_trigger.note: Skew-borne availability events reach 8-K materiality only at Knight scale (conditional); OCC-style resilience discipline and DORA/FCA operational-resilience map directly.
